recommendation: Keep the core audit commit, and reconcile the Extension Pack by removing the current questionnaire-choiceOrientation contextInvariant while preserving the constrained-list note. Also check the SDC implementation guide reference noted in the March 2026 SDC minutes when an updated Extension Pack is published.
issue_request: FHIR-56057 is a Published FHIR-extensions / FHIR-I issue, resolved Persuasive with Modification, requesting removal of the questionnaire-choiceOrientation context expression and addition of explanatory text that the extension is relevant for constrained lists of permitted answers.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in the FHIR Extension Pack by commit aad7382, which removed the prior contextInvariant and added the constrained-list note.
additional_context: FHIR-52745 is the earlier same-extension issue asking to allow all choice answer types. In Extension Pack commit order, FHIR-52745 commit 424aae2 and FHIRPath fix a7598a2 later reintroduced a broader contextInvariant, so current Extension Pack master retains the FHIR-56057 note but not its no-context-expression resolution. Core source has only OID metadata and historical bundles for this extension.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the core combined branch. No core files were changed because the authoritative file is in HL7/fhir-extensions.

related_jiras.note: Earlier issue for broadening allowed choice item types; its Extension Pack application reintroduced a broader contextInvariant after FHIR-56057's removal commit.
Earlier version-specific contextInvariant issue that led to the broader choiceOrientation constraint reconsideration.
